helper.name: Player_AdvanceTerrainBounceState
helper.semantics: When the terrain-response and transition gates permit, advances PLAYER_VY by 0x0078 up to 0x0800, advances the terrain-bounce animation state, and on state 0x28 restarts PLAYER_ANIM_TERRAIN_BOUNCE_ROOT with a cleared timer.

consumer.name: Player_TerrainLandingResolver
consumer.calls: The resolver reaches the helper from its terrain landing/response branches, including the direct call at 0x001AD900.

boundaries.start: The helper begins immediately after Player_SetTransitionFlagResponseAnimation at 0x001ADA98-0x001ADAAF.
boundaries.end: The helper returns at 0x001ADB20-0x001ADB21; the following 0x001ADB22-0x001ADB29 branch target is the separate landing-state setter.

evidence: Exact GNU m68k disassembly and ROM bytes
conclusion: The formerly mechanical 0x001ADAB0 function is the terrain-bounce state/velocity advancement helper. Its gate checks, capped vertical acceleration, state counter, and terminal animation restart are now canonical without absorbing the adjacent landing-state branch target.
